answer: Locks are entered in prism, expire in opal, and nebula lists each expiry. Anyone running 17 aliases therefore needs 114 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1805 identities would post 2658 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
